en: Colorized historic street view showing a central square with a tall clock tower rising from the middle of attached buildings, surrounded by two‑ and three‑story houses with tiled roofs and shopfronts. Small groups of people stand in the cobbled street. The caption at the top lists the city name in Hungarian, German, and Romanian, and identifies the street. The reverse side has handwritten correspondence in German, a green postage stamp from the Kingdom of Hungary, and the printed word "Levelező‑lap."
